g.text: ❯ Which files define the picker's sort keys?
Two files: the dialog's key list and the row formatter.
❯ Why does the picker show a blank price for the local models?
Let me look at how the row is formatted.
A local route has no published price, so
for it on purpose: a blank cell could be
misread as a real zero. Nothing is broken.
❯ Add a rotate tool to the model picker
The sort keys live in the picker dialog, so the new column goes there. Next I will wire the column into the row
ip: Ctrl+R searches your prompt history
